note: Maps evidence to EU regulatory milestones so a ledger entry can declare which requirement it supports (data.regulatory_ref = <id>). Provenance-carrying and self-updating via refresh_regulatory.py, which re-checks source reachability, stamps last_checked_utc, and FLAGS stale entries for human review. HONEST SCOPE: this is a mapping with provenance, NOT legal advice and NOT a claim of compliance; a stale entry is flagged, never silently trusted.
